item.title: Stocks fell 2% for a sixth straight day. Here is how the slide reaches your 401(k).
item.description:
US stocks fell for a sixth straight day on Thursday. The Dow lost 1,101 points, or 2.19%, the S&P 500 2.02% and the Nasdaq 2.25%, and all 11 sectors fell. AMD dropped 7.72% after a short report. Futures were lower again early Friday.
Our read, labeled as judgment: selling after a drop locks in the loss. General information, not investment advice. More at fiopoin.com

item.title: Anthropic's record $81 billion IPO trades today. Here is how it reaches your wallet.
item.description:
Anthropic priced its IPO at $83 a share, raising $81 billion, the largest listing on record, at a value near $1.5 trillion. It starts trading on the Nasdaq today as ANT. Nasdaq 100 futures rose 1.83% early Thursday. Amazon owns 14.7% and Google 13.7%, so most index funds already hold a slice.
Our read, labeled as judgment: expect a volatile first week. General information, not investment advice. More at fiopoin.com

item.title: Nvidia beat and raised its forecast. Here is how that reaches your 401(k).
item.description:
Nvidia reported $115.8 billion in third quarter revenue, up 103%, and guided to $130 billion next quarter versus $125.25 billion expected (LSEG). Shares rose 3.7% before the open and Nasdaq 100 futures about 1.2%. If you own an index fund, you own a lot of Nvidia. Our read, labeled as judgment: expect big swings this week. General information, not investment advice. More at fiopoin.com

item.title: Oil just fell to its lowest since August. Your gas tank is next.
item.description:
One event, five steps to your wallet. The IEA says oil supply now tops demand, US crude closed at its lowest since August 28, and the gas average is $3.81, down about 54 cents since mid October. Markets still price 91% odds of a Fed hike December 9 (market odds). What it means for you at fiopoin.com
